system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform this action twice simultaneously for two different entities: agristack_register_farmer.. my district is dummy_district_3240, my village is dummy_village_3820, my state is dummy_state_6803, my farmer_name is dummy_farmer_name_3820, my aadhaar_number is 100020009123.

function.name: agristack_register_farmer
function.description: Registers a new farmer in the AgriStack registry. Each Aadhaar can have ONLY one profile (duplicates rejected). Transitions profile_status to 'registered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT verify land or complete profile. Fails if Aadhaar already registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
